einzeiler: Two eerie real-life accounts, including a vanishing student and a preserved corpse in a…
kurzfassung: A Chinese high school student enters an abandoned building with friends and vanishes, leaving only one classmate who remembers him. Decades earlier in Mexico, a grieving mother preserves her daughter's corpse and displays it as a wedding mannequin. Both chilling accounts explore strange anomalies and urban legends based on real events.
stichpunkte: A 17-year-old student named Henry and his friend Pan enter an abandoned school basement in China in 2013.
Pan wanders off in pitch darkness to retrieve a lost shuttlecock and completely disappears.
Upon escaping the basement, Henry and Lee discover that nobody else remembers Pan existing, and all records of him have vanished.
Psychiatrists attribute Henry's memories to stress-induced hallucination, while others speculate about parallel universes or the Mandela effect.
In 1930 Mexico, dress shop owner Danya Esparza eagerly awaits her daughter Pasqualita's return from a canceled wedding trip to France.
Pasqualita arrives looking remarkably refreshed, but the truth is she died from a scorpion sting right before the wedding.
Danya had her daughter's corpse embalmed in France, fitted with glass eyes, and displayed it in the shop window as a mannequin.
Generations later, descendants continue to display the corpse as a wedding dress model while denying its true nature.
